component.name: Pprof-Viz
component.summary: Live visualizer for Go runtime metrics streamed via ConnectRPC

description.p: A modern, real-time desktop dashboard for visualizing Go runtime telemetry. Pprof-Viz is a cross-platform desktop application built with Tauri v2 and Svelte 5. It serves as the frontend for the pprof-viz-agent backend, providing a comprehensive, real-time visualization of Go's internal runtime/metrics.

Unlike standard pprof, which is designed for ad-hoc, deep-dive stack trace analysis, Pprof-Viz is built for continuous, high-resolution monitoring. It transforms live telemetry streams into an intuitive dashboard, giving you immediate insight into CPU usage, Garbage Collection behavior, memory allocation, and scheduler latencies.

ul.li: Real-time telemetry: seamlessly streams and visualizes live Go runtime metrics.
Session awareness: status bar showing active profiling state, elapsed time, and collected samples.
Dedicated dashboards: route-based views for CPU, GC, Memory, Scheduler, and Miscellaneous metrics.
Profile management: built-in collection profile selection and lifecycle controls.
Native desktop: distributed as .dmg (macOS), .msi (Windows), and Flatpak (Linux).

description.p: For a complete monitoring setup: embed pprof-viz-agent in your Go application, install Pprof-Viz, then connect to your agent's endpoint.
